item.title: Microsoft turns to AWS as GitHub faces AI capacity crunch
Amazon Announces Multibillion-Dollar Data Center in Missouri
item.description:
📝 Amazon Web Services is making a major push into Missouri with a multibillion-dollar investment in a new data center campus in Montgomery County, the company announced today. Amazon is also committing over $7 million in direct community contributions, including: $3 million for emergency dispatch services and public safety infrastructure Over $1 million for a new community gathering space at the Montgomery County Fairgrounds Additional funding for roadway and water infrastructure improvements STEM education programs, teacher grants, and the new Amazon Montgomery County Community Fund for local projects The company will donate completed water infrastructure to the local public water supply district at no cost. Amazon executives emphasized long-term partnership and community benefits.
🔗 Read more: https://www.narracomm.com/amazon-announces-multibillion-dollar-data-center-in-missouri/

item.title: Salesforce to Acquire Fin (formerly Intercom) for $3.6B
item.description:
📝 “Fin brings proven agent technology, a deep commitment to customer success, and an incredible AI team that will complement Agentforce with powerful service agent capabilities. Fin’s AI agent technology will help organizations improve autonomous resolution, reduce cost-to-serve, and accelerate AI adoption across their service organizations. The transaction will not impact Salesforce’s capital return program.
🔗 Read more: https://www.salesforce.com/news/press-releases/2026/06/15/salesforce-signs-definitive-agreement-to-acquire-fin/?bc=HL
